 ('publication',['python3','-B',str(b/'publish.py')]),
 ('current-after-v3',['python3','-B',str(b/'current_snapshot.py'),'after','--prefix','v3-']),
 ('book-source',['python3','-B','scripts/book_source_references.py','--write']),
 ('source-published-v3',['python3','-B',str(b/'intake.py'),'--published','--prefix','v3-']),
 ('focused',['prove','-v','t/2066-record-value-current-publication.t','t/2067-record-value-gate-streams.t','t/1549-task-tree-integrity-doctrine.t','t/1636-claim-verification-doctrine.t','t/1638-claim-verification-dispositions.t','t/1303-isf-public-live-book-paths-audit.t','t/1305-isf-book-feature-matrix-audit.t']),
 ('book',['mdbook','build','docs/book']),
 ('native',['python3','-B','scripts/check_record_value_publication.py','--build','docs/book/book']),
 ('book-native',['python3','-B',str(b/'book_native.py')]),
 ('size',['scripts/check_live_document_size.sh']),
 ('claims',['scripts/check_claim_verification.pl']),
 ('inventory-write',['scripts/check_claim_verification_inventory.pl','--write']),
 ('inventory',['scripts/check_claim_verification_inventory.pl']),
 ('whitespace',['git','diff','--cached','--check']),
 ('seal',['python3','-B',str(b/'verify.py'),'--seal']),
 ('default',['python3','-B',str(b/'verify.py')])]
for label,command in rows:
 if label == 'size':
  subprocess.run(['git','add','MEMORY.md','docs/TASK_TREE.md','docs/tasks/SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.md','doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl','docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md',str(b)],check=True)

 instrument='resource_observer.py' if label in ('seal','default') else 'capture.py'
 subprocess.run(['python3','-B',str(b/instrument),label,*command],check=True)
 d=json.loads((b/(label+'-actual.json')).read_bytes())
 if type(d['status']) is not int or d['status'] != 0 or type(d['expected_status']) is not int or d['expected_status'] != 0:
  raise ValueError('actual/declared delivery gate: '+label)
print('PASS all frozen formal canonical preparation delivery gates.',flush=True)
